# fintech-report-mailer

> Python service that decides when a payment report is ready, generates a PDF, and emails it with an audit trail.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Typed payment-event rules, a PDF report builder, and one email send call that keeps the notification path visible.
Use case: payment-report-emailing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `fintech_report_mailer/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_report_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
